system.description: Autochthonian procedure. Transfers the spirit of a destined hero from a mortal soulgem to an Alchemical soulgem. Performed in a small room with the Maker's Essence-conducting arteries exposed. The Luminor connects the soulgems via a ritually severed cable and invokes the Great Maker's presence. The mortal gem goes dark as the Alchemical gem blazes bright.
